text: One morning Aris's workshop was found standing open, her tea cold and her tools left on the bench as if she'd stepped out. Nobody saw her leave.
Aris wrote in her notebook: "H. crossed the lane again rather than pass my door." "R. told Mirela I'm not one of us any more."

leads.text: Who's H.? Henrietta never goes near the maker space. Ask her how she got on with Aris.

text: Kofi saw Aris heading down Banyan Row's steps towards the old metro at about 21:40 the evening before she went missing, with Raymond going the other way.

leads.text: She was heading for the old metro. See whether anything down there remembers her.
Raymond passed her on the steps. Ask him whether he saw her that evening.

text: Raymond says he and Aris always got on fine.
